_notes.geometry: Ra/Rb from paper Key Parameters table; hinge pair half-angles (delta_base/delta_platform) and platform_phase_deg=0 are an explicit assumption - paper does not specify exact hinge angles (decision #1, see README). phase=0 gives every leg the same neutral length l0_i (balanced load sharing) regardless of delta_base vs delta_platform; the two half-angles must differ substantially (~40 deg gap) to avoid a kinematic singularity that occurs when every leg is a pure rotation of the others (equal half-angles).
_notes.z0_mid: (0.621+0.985)/2 m, exact midpoint of the paper Table 1 heave range
_notes.m_rod/k_spring/b_damp/F_rod_max: not given numerically in the paper - engineering estimates for a ~1 m hydraulic actuator rod (decision #2: u is a direct force in N)
_notes.F_eq/m_platform: shipboard equipment load and platform mass from paper Key Parameters table
_notes.comm_delay_samples: 1 ms UDP delay at Ts=5ms (paper sec. 4.2) modelled as a 1-sample held delay (decision #5)
